verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Job . . . answered
verses.literalPt: Então, respondeu Jó:

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וּתְהִי־ זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū šā·mô·aʿ mil·lā·ṯî ū·ṯə·hî- zōṯ tan·ḥū·mō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Listen carefully . . . to my words let this be your consolation to me
verses.literalPt: Ouvi atentamente as minhas palavras; seja isso a consolação que me quereis dar.

verses.original: שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣י תַלְעִֽיג׃
verses.transliteration: śā·ʾû·nî wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·ḏab·bêr wə·’a·ḥar dab·bə·rî ṯal·‘îḡ
verses.literal: Bear with me while I speak then, after I have spoken you may go on mocking
verses.literalPt: Permiti-me que eu também fale; e, havendo eu falado, zombai.

verses.original: הֶ֭אָנֹכִי לְאָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑י וְאִם־ מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹא־ תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: he·’ā·nō·ḵî lə·’ā·ḏām śî·ḥî wə·’im- mad·dū·a‘ lō- ṯiq·ṣar rū·ḥî
verses.literal: Is my complaint . . . against a man Then why should I not . . . be impatient
verses.literalPt: É, porventura, do homem que eu me queixo? Não tenho motivo de me impacientar?

verses.original: פְּנוּ־ אֵלַ֥י וְהָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְשִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל־ פֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: pə·nū- ’ê·lay wə·hā·šam·mū wə·śî·mū yāḏ ‘al- peh
verses.literal: Look at me and be appalled put your hand over your mouth
verses.literalPt: Olhai para mim, e pasmai, e ponde a mão sobre a vossa boca.

verses.original: וְאִם־ זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְאָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י פַּלָּצֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- zā·ḵar·tî wə·niḇ·hā·lə·tî wə·’ā·ḥaz bə·śā·rî pal·lā·ṣūṯ
verses.literal: When I remember terror takes hold and my body trembles in horror
verses.literalPt: Mesmo de pensar nisso, me perturbo, e o horror apodera-se da minha carne.

verses.original: מַדּ֣וּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם־ גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ rə·šā·‘îm yiḥ·yū ‘ā·ṯə·qū gam- gā·ḇə·rū ḥā·yil
verses.literal: Why do the wicked live on growing old and increasing in power
verses.literalPt: Por que vivem os iníquos, se envelhecem e se robustecem em poder?

verses.original: זַרְעָ֤ם נָכ֣וֹן לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑ם וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֗ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zar·‘ām nā·ḵō·wn lip̄·nê·hem ‘im·mām wə·ṣe·’ĕ·ṣā·’ê·hem lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: Their descendants are established around them . . . and their offspring before their eyes
verses.literalPt: Seus filhos estabelecem-se com eles à sua vista, e os seus descendentes, diante dos seus olhos.

verses.original: בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִפָּ֑חַד וְלֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bāt·tê·hem šā·lō·wm mip·pā·ḥaḏ wə·lō šê·ḇeṭ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Their homes are safe from fear no rod of punishment from God is upon them
verses.literalPt: As suas casas estão livres de medo, e a vara de Deus não cai sobre eles.

verses.original: שׁוֹר֣וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְלֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šō·w·rōw ‘ib·bar wə·lō yaḡ·‘il tə·p̄al·lêṭ pā·rā·ṯōw wə·lō ṯə·šak·kêl
verses.literal: Their bulls breed without fail their cows bear calves and do not miscarry
verses.literalPt: O seu touro gera e não falha; pare a sua vaca e não aborta.

verses.original: יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭צֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝יַלְדֵיהֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: yə·šal·lə·ḥū ḵaṣ·ṣōn ‘ă·wî·lê·hem wə·yal·ḏê·hem yə·raq·qê·ḏūn
verses.literal: They send forth their little ones like a flock their children skip about
verses.literalPt: Fazem sair a seus filhos como um rebanho, e os seus pequenos saltam e brincam.

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּתֹ֣ף וְכִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·’ū kə·ṯōp̄ wə·ḵin·nō·wr wə·yiś·mə·ḥū lə·qō·wl ‘ū·ḡāḇ
verses.literal: singing to the tambourine and lyre and making merry at the sound of the flute
verses.literalPt: Cantam ao som do tamboril e da harpa e regozijam-se ao som da flauta.

verses.original: יְבַלּוּ בַטּ֣וֹב יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בְרֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḇal·lū ḇaṭ·ṭō·wḇ yə·mê·hem ū·ḇə·re·ḡa‘ šə·’ō·wl yê·ḥāt·tū
verses.literal: They spend their days in prosperity and go down to Sheol in peace
verses.literalPt: Passam os seus dias em prosperidade e, num momento, descem ao Sheol.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְדַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lā·’êl sūr mim·men·nū wə·ḏa·‘aṯ də·rā·ḵe·ḵā lō ḥā·p̄ā·ṣə·nū
verses.literal: Yet they say to God Leave us alone . . . For we have no desire to know Your ways
verses.literalPt: Contudo, disseram a Deus: Retira-te de nós, pois não desejamos conhecer os teus caminhos.

verses.original: מַה־ שַׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי־ נַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ וּמַה־ נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- šad·day kî- na·‘aḇ·ḏen·nū ū·mah- nō·w·‘îl kî nip̄·ga‘- bōw
verses.literal: Who is the Almighty that we should serve Him and what would we gain if we pray to Him
verses.literalPt: Que é o Todo-Poderoso, para que o sirvamos? Que nos aproveitará, se lhe dirigirmos orações?

verses.original: הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְיָדָ֣ם טוּבָ֑ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: hên lō ḇə·yā·ḏām ṭū·ḇām ‘ă·ṣaṯ rə·šā·‘îm rā·ḥă·qāh men·nî
verses.literal: Still their prosperity is not in their own hands so I stay far . . . from the counsel of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Eis que não está nas mãos deles a sua prosperidade. Longe de mim o conselho dos iníquos!

verses.original: כַּמָּ֤ה׀ נֵר־ רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְיָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣ימוֹ אֵידָ֑ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּאַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kam·māh nêr- rə·šā·‘îm yiḏ·‘āḵ wə·yā·ḇō ‘ā·lê·mōw ’ê·ḏām ḥă·ḇā·lîm yə·ḥal·lêq bə·’ap·pōw
verses.literal: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out Does disaster come upon them Does God, in His anger apportion destruction
verses.literalPt: Quantas vezes sucede que se apaga a lâmpada dos iníquos? Que lhes sobrevém a calamidade? Que Deus, na sua ira, lhes distribui dores?

verses.original: יִהְי֗וּ כְּתֶ֥בֶן לִפְנֵי־ ר֑וּחַ וּ֝כְמֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yih·yū kə·ṯe·ḇen lip̄·nê- rū·aḥ ū·ḵə·mōṣ gə·nā·ḇat·tū sū·p̄āh
verses.literal: Are they like straw before the wind like chaff swept away by a storm
verses.literalPt: Que eles são como a palha diante do vento e como a pragana que a tempestade leva?

verses.original: אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן־ לְבָנָ֥יו אוֹנ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣יו וְיֵדָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·w·ah yiṣ·pōn- lə·ḇā·nāw ’ō·w·nōw yə·šal·lêm ’ê·lāw wə·yê·ḏā‘
verses.literal: It is said that God lays up one’s punishment for his children Let God repay the man himself so he will know it
verses.literalPt: Deus, dizeis vós, reserva a iniquidade do pai para seus filhos, mas é a ele mesmo que Deus deveria punir, para que o sinta.

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ עֵינוֹ כִּיד֑וֹ וּמֵחֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’ū ʿē·nō kî·ḏōw ū·mê·ḥă·maṯ šad·day yiš·teh
verses.literal: Let his eyes see his own destruction let him drink for himself the wrath of the Almighty
verses.literalPt: Vejam os seus próprios olhos a sua destruição, e beba ele do furor do Todo-Poderoso.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מַה־ חֶפְצ֣וֹ בְּבֵית֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וּמִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣יו חֻצָּֽצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mah- ḥep̄·ṣōw bə·ḇê·ṯōw ’a·ḥă·rāw ū·mis·par ḥo·ḏā·šāw ḥuṣ·ṣā·ṣū
verses.literal: For what does he care about his household after him when the number of his months has run out
verses.literalPt: Pois que se lhe dá a ele da sua casa depois de morto, quando lhe for cortado o número dos seus meses?

verses.original: הַלְאֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד־ דָּ֑עַת וְ֝ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: hal·’êl yə·lam·meḏ- dā·‘aṯ wə·hū rā·mîm yiš·pō·wṭ
verses.literal: Can anyone teach knowledge to God since He judges those on high
verses.literalPt: Acaso, a Deus ensinará alguém ciência, desde que é ele quem julga os que são elevados?

verses.original: זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּעֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְשָׁלֵֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: zeh yā·mūṯ bə·‘e·ṣem tum·mōw kul·lōw šal·’ă·nan wə·šā·lêw
verses.literal: One man dies full of vigor . . . completely secure and at ease
verses.literalPt: Um morre em seu pleno vigor, inteiramente sossegado e tranquilo;

verses.original: עֲ֭טִינָיו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּמֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣יו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṭî·nāw mā·lə·’ū ḥā·lāḇ ū·mō·aḥ ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯāw yə·šuq·qeh
verses.literal: His body is well nourished . . . and his bones are rich with marrow
verses.literalPt: com os seus baldes cheios de leite e a medula dos seus ossos umedecida;

verses.original: וְזֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּטּוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh yā·mūṯ bə·ne·p̄eš mā·rāh wə·lō- ’ā·ḵal baṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: Yet another man dies in the bitterness of his soul having never tasted prosperity
verses.literalPt: outro, porém, morre em amargura de alma e nunca prova o bem;

verses.original: יַ֭חַד עַל־ עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ya·ḥaḏ ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār yiš·kā·ḇū wə·rim·māh tə·ḵas·seh ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: But together they lie down in the dust and worms cover them both
verses.literalPt: dormem juntamente no pó, cobrem-nos os vermes.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וּ֝מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hên yā·ḏa‘·tî maḥ·šə·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ū·mə·zim·mō·wṯ ‘ā·lay taḥ·mō·sū
verses.literal: Behold I know your thoughts full well the schemes by which you would wrong me
verses.literalPt: Eis que conheço os vossos pensamentos e os desígnios que injustamente imaginais contra mim.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תֹֽאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית־ נָדִ֑יב וְ֝אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל׀ מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯō·mə·rū ’ay·yêh ḇêṯ- nā·ḏîḇ wə·’ay·yêh ’ō·hel miš·kə·nō·wṯ rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: For you say Where now is the nobleman’s house and where are the tents in which the wicked dwell
verses.literalPt: Pois dizeis: Onde está a casa do príncipe? Onde está a tenda em que moravam os iníquos?

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝אֹתֹתָ֗ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō šə·ʾel·tem ‘ō·wḇ·rê ḏā·reḵ wə·’ō·ṯō·ṯām lō ṯə·nak·kê·rū
verses.literal: Have you never asked those who travel the roads Do you not accept their reports
verses.literalPt: Porventura, não tendes interrogado aos viandantes? E desconheceis os fatos da sua experiência:

verses.original: כִּ֤י לְי֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְי֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî lə·yō·wm ’êḏ yê·ḥā·śeḵ rā‘ lə·yō·wm ‘ă·ḇā·rō·wṯ yū·ḇā·lū
verses.literal: Indeed the evil man is spared from the day of calamity delivered from the day of wrath
verses.literalPt: que os homens maus são poupados no dia da calamidade, que são protegidos no dia do furor?

verses.original: מִֽי־ יַגִּ֣יד עַל־ פָּנָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֽוּא־ עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yag·gîḏ ‘al- pā·nāw dar·kōw wə·hū- ‘ā·śāh mî yə·šal·lem- lōw
verses.literal: Who denounces his behavior to his face Who repays him for what he has done
verses.literalPt: Quem lhe lançará no rosto o seu caminho? Quem lhe dará o pago do que fez?

verses.original: וְ֭הוּא לִקְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽעַל־ גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū liq·ḇā·rō·wṯ yū·ḇāl wə·‘al- gā·ḏîš yiš·qō·wḏ
verses.literal: He is carried to the grave and watch is kept over his tomb
verses.literalPt: Contudo, ele é levado para a sepultura, e vigiam-lhe o túmulo.

verses.original: מָֽתְקוּ־ ל֗וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י נָ֥חַל וְ֭אַחֲרָיו כָּל־ אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ṯə·qū- lōw riḡ·ḇê nā·ḥal wə·’a·ḥă·rāw kāl- ’ā·ḏām yim·šō·wḵ ū·lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: The clods of the valley are sweet to him everyone . . . follows behind him and those before him are without number
verses.literalPt: Os torrões do vale lhe são leves, e todos os homens o imitarão, como ele o fez aos inumeráveis predecessores.

verses.original: וְ֭אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּנִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝תְשֽׁוּבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר־ מָֽעַל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’êḵ tə·na·ḥă·mū·nî hā·ḇel ū·ṯə·šū·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem niš·’ar- mā·‘al
verses.literal: So how can you comfort me with empty words For your answers remain full of falsehood
verses.literalPt: Como, pois, me ofereceis consolações vãs, visto que das vossas respostas só resta a falsidade?
